pages.title: Diminishing Returns
pages.text: Eating the same food repeatedly gives $(bold)less and less nutrition each time$(). This is $(thing)diminishing returns$().$(br2)The more often you eat something, the lower its nutritional value becomes. Returns recover naturally — the longer you go without eating something, the more nutrition it gives when you eat it again.

pages.title: The Novelty Bonus
pages.text: Eating a food you have never had — or not had in a long time — gives a $(c:#52c252)$(bold)novelty bonus$()$() of up to $(bold)25% extra nutrition$().$(br2)This bonus fades the more you eat that food.$(br2)$(italic)Variety is always rewarded. Rotate your foods and you will consistently get better nutrition than eating the same thing every meal.$()
